say:1:1430229201:1.text: She is nothing but a servant! With nothing to her name! What do you think she possesses to quell my anger?! Only blood will suffice!
say:1:1430229201:1.source_cn: 作为一个一无所有的仆从，你觉得她能用什么来熄灭我的怒火！
